item.title: How Savannah James is making a difference beyond basketball
item.summary: With a strong commitment to philanthropy and entrepreneurship, Savannah James has made a name for herself. Her collaboration with K+ Organics has resulted in healthier sports drink options for young athletes. Moreover, the James family’s generous donation of over forty million dollars to education in Akron showcases their dedication. Savannah’s initiatives, including I PROMise Makeover and Women of Our Future, emphasize her focus on nurturing family, health, and educational growth.
